Why I'm Watching It
TSS is evolving from a low-margin procurement business into a higher-value AI infrastructure integrator, with systems integration and facilities management becoming increasingly impornt drivers of earnings. Its deep relationship with Dell positions the company directly in the path of rapidly expanding rack-scale AI infrastructure demand, while operating leverage could allow cash flow to grow far faster than headline revenue.
